title: Array-lift resweep: 46 of 47 probe cases; the one miss belongs outside the group
status_plain: A 2026-06-20 resweep against live Excel 16.0 build 20026 re-scored this stream's own array-lift and scalar-coercion rows on the typed-arg local-eval path. The tallies are Row-1 23/23, Row-2+Row-3 19/20, Row-4 4/4, and the closure checklist records the total as "array-lift 46/47". The 47 counts PROBE CASES arranged in four table rows, not surfaces: 23+19+4 = 46 over 23+20+4 = 47. The single non-match is TBILLYIELD at 1 ULP on one settlement, which the source itself reclassifies as a numeric drift rather than an array-admission failure and moves to the catalogue G6 row. TBILLYIELD is not one of the surfaces this record carries, so for each surface here the honest statement is "the one or two cases this surface contributed to the group matched" - not "46 of 47". The source's own membership list is open-ended: GCD, LCM, MULTINOMIAL, ARRAYTOTEXT, ISEVEN, QUOTIENT, ROMAN and BIN2OCT are named literally; DATEDIF, DATEVALUE, TIMEVALUE, DAYS360, TBILLEQ and TBILLPRICE are here because the sentence writes "IS*", "the date family" and "TBILL*" followed by an ellipsis. Exact membership is not recoverable from the source, which the harvest's own caveat puts at approximately 20 surfaces. Neither the resweep sentence nor the stream's Ref notes names a host CPU or an architecture.
